method.en: Each field is read from the official constitutional or statutory text cited in its sources, in the version stated there. Election-specific electoral rules come from the stored rule record of each admitted election. Fields that could not be read are marked pending instead of being filled. Labels describe constitutional rules; they are not scores or rankings.
method.zh: 每个字段均依其来源所列官方宪法或法律文本（按所注版本）读取。各届选举的具体规则取自每届已收录选举的规则记录。无法阅读的字段标为“待核实”，不作填补。标签描述宪法规则，不是评分或排名。

label.zh: 选举制度（下院或唯一议院）

dual_executive_parliamentary_confidence.zh: 直选元首，政府依赖议会信任

simple_majority_of_all_members.zh: 全体议员过半数；无须选出继任者

simple_majority_half_present.zh: 半数议员出席时的明确决议

list_pr_districts.zh: 多议席选区名单比例代表制

list_pr_national.en: List PR in one national district
list_pr_national.zh: 单一全国选区名单比例代表制

personalised_pr.zh: 结合选区候选人的比例代表制

mixed.zh: 单议席与名单议席混合

federal_council.en: Federal organ of the Länder (not elected)
federal_council.zh: 各州参与联邦事务的机关（非选举产生）
